past_actions.summary: Host a private dinner with my general managers across all four locations to communicate a long-term vision message: Regional Auto Group is a family institution, not an exit strategy. I am signaling to my leadership team that the business is being built to last, not sold. This reinforces culture, reduces turnover anxiety at the management level, and begins planting the narrative of succession and institutional continuity.

Call an all-hands leadership meeting across all four locations within the next 72 hours. Acknowledge the RoboRide announcement directly — do not let rumors and 'business closing' whispers fill the vacuum. Deliver a clear message: Regional Auto Group has navigated every disruption in its history, we are assessing this one with clear eyes, and no decisions about staffing or structure will be made in panic. Frame the threat honestly but not catastrophically. The goal is to stop the bleeding of morale before it starts, not to pretend there is no wound.
past_actions.emotional_state: controlled alarm — the kind that sharpens rather than scatters
